pieces.Text: A creature bit by an attic whisperer must make a DC

Will save or become fatigued for 1 hour.  A fatigued creature that is bitten is instead exhausted for 1 hour, and an exhausted creature falls asleep for 1 hour if bitten.  The sleeper can only be roused by killing the attic whisperer or by using dispel magic, remove curse, or similar effects.
